title: Eugene Stratton
html_source:
Eugene Augustus Rühlmann (1861 – 1918) was born in Buffalo, New York. He adopted the stage name Eugene Stratton, and became a dancer and singer, whose career was mostly spent in British music halls. Although at one time he used an Irish voice, he mainly appeared as a “black-faced” minstrel singer.
